bss.topic: Revisão do 1º trimestre: território, população e economia

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quantas são as grandes regiões do Brasil segundo a divisão oficial do IBGE?
questions.hint: Pense em Norte, Sul e as outras.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual região brasileira tem a maior área territorial?
questions.hint: É a região onde está a maior parte da Floresta Amazônica.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual região brasileira tem a maior população?
questions.hint: É a região dos estados de São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Minas Gerais.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama o deslocamento de pessoas do campo para as cidades?
questions.hint: A primeira palavra significa 'saída'.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A densidade demográfica de um lugar é calculada dividindo:
questions.hint: A unidade é habitantes por km².

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Um município tem 50.000 habitantes e 250 km² de área. Qual é sua densidade demográfica, em habitantes por km²?
questions.hint: Divida a população pela área.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Na divisão em três regiões geoeconômicas, quais são os três complexos regionais do Brasil?
questions.hint: Essa divisão não segue os limites dos estados.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é a principal fonte de geração de energia elétrica no Brasil?
questions.hint: O país tem muitos rios caudalosos com desníveis.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A usina de Itaipu, no rio Paraná, é compartilhada entre o Brasil e qual país?
questions.hint: É um país vizinho sem saída para o mar.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Uma pirâmide etária com a base cada vez mais estreita e o topo mais largo indica que a população está:
questions.hint: Pense em quem fica na base e quem fica no topo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Um gráfico mostra que, em 1950, a maioria dos brasileiros vivia no campo e, hoje, a grande maioria vive em cidades. Esse processo é chamado de:
questions.hint: A palavra vem de 'urbano'.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual combustível renovável é produzido em grande escala no Brasil a partir da cana-de-açúcar?
questions.hint: É usado em carros flex.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes é um problema ambiental ligado à construção de grandes usinas hidrelétricas?
options: Alagamento de grandes áreas de floresta e terras
Aumento da poluição do ar por fumaça
questions.answer: Alagamento de grandes áreas de floresta e terras
questions.hint: Pense no que acontece com a área do reservatório.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em um mapa temático do Brasil, a legenda serve para:
options: explicar o significado das cores e símbolos
questions.answer: explicar o significado das cores e símbolos
questions.hint: Sem ela, as cores não teriam significado.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique um motivo pelo qual muitas pessoas migraram do Nordeste para o Sudeste ao longo do século XX.
questions.hint: Pense em empregos e na industrialização.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Cite uma consequência negativa da urbanização rápida nas grandes cidades brasileiras e explique por que ela acontece.
questions.hint: Pense em moradia, transporte ou saneamento.

comp.topic: Term 1 review: security, Python and data representation

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the binary number 1010 to denary.
questions.hint: Use place values 8, 4, 2, 1.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the denary number 13 to 4-bit binary.
questions.hint: Find which of 8, 4, 2 and 1 add up to 13.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the hexadecimal digit B to denary.
questions.hint: A is 10.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the denary number 47 to hexadecimal.
questions.hint: 47 = 2 × 16 + remainder.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: How many bits are in one byte?
questions.hint: A nibble is half a byte.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Why do programmers often use hexadecimal instead of binary?
options: It is shorter and easier for humans to read
questions.answer: It is shorter and easier for humans to read
questions.hint: One hex digit stands for 4 bits.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q:
What does this Python code print?
x = 5
x = x + 3
print(x * 2)
questions.hint: Trace the value of x line by line.

questions.subject: comp
questions.hint: range starts at 0 by default.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: In Python, what is the data type of the value "42" (with quotation marks)?
questions.hint: Look at the quotation marks.

questions.subject: comp
questions.hint: Is 12 greater than or equal to 13?

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: An AND gate has inputs A = 1 and B = 0. What is the output?
options: It depends on a third input
questions.hint: AND needs both inputs to be 1.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which logic gate outputs 1 when at least one input is 1?

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: An email asks you to click a link and 'confirm your password' to avoid your account being closed. What kind of attack is this most likely to be?
questions.hint: The attacker is 'fishing' for details.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Explain why a computer stores all data, such as numbers, text and images, in binary.
questions.hint: Think about the two states of an electronic switch.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Convert the binary number 110011 to denary.
questions.hint: Use place values 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which of these is the strongest password?
questions.hint: Think about length and variety of characters.

en.topic: Term 1 review: grammar and creative writing

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which of these is a main clause?
questions.hint: A main clause makes sense on its own.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In the sentence 'Although it was late, Maya kept reading', which part is the subordinate clause?
questions.hint: Look for the part that cannot stand alone.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Identify the relative pronoun in this sentence: 'The boy who won the race was delighted.'
questions.hint: It introduces extra information about the boy.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses a semicolon correctly?
options: The sun had set; the streets grew cold.
The sun; had set and the streets grew cold.
The sun had set; and the streets.
; The sun had set, the streets grew cold.
questions.answer: The sun had set; the streets grew cold.
questions.hint: A semicolon joins two closely linked main clauses.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses a colon correctly?
options: She packed three things: a torch, a map and a coat.
She packed: three things a torch.
She packed three things a torch: a map.
questions.answer: She packed three things: a torch, a map and a coat.
questions.hint: A colon can introduce a list.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses an apostrophe correctly?
questions.hint: The apostrophe shows that the bowl belongs to the cat.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Correct the punctuation error in this sentence and write the corrected word: 'Its going to rain today.'
questions.hint: Is it a contraction or a possessive?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is a comma splice?
options: Joining two main clauses with only a comma
Using a comma in a list
Putting a comma before a quotation
questions.answer: Joining two main clauses with only a comma

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence is a comma splice?
options: I was hungry, I ate a sandwich.
I was hungry, so I ate a sandwich.
Because I was hungry, I ate a sandwich.
I was hungry; I ate a sandwich.
questions.answer: I was hungry, I ate a sandwich.
questions.hint: Which one joins two complete sentences with just a comma?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: 'Dark clouds gathered as the stranger approached the house.' Which narrative technique uses weather to reflect mood?
questions.hint: The weather mirrors the tension.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A story suddenly jumps back to an event from the narrator's childhood. What is this technique called?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: 'Little did she know, this was the last time she would see the old key.' What technique is this?
questions.hint: It hints at what will happen later.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which opening uses a first-person narrator?
options: I had never seen the sea so still.
She had never seen the sea so still.
They had never seen the sea so still.
The sea had never been so still.
questions.answer: I had never seen the sea so still.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A writer wants to slow down a tense moment. Which edit would help most?
options: Add precise sensory detail and short sentences
Skip ahead to the next day
Add a long list of characters' names
questions.answer: Add precise sensory detail and short sentences
questions.hint: Think about how readers feel time passing.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Rewrite this sentence to make it more vivid, using at least one technique you have studied: 'The forest was scary.'
questions.hint: Try sensory detail, a simile or personification.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Explain the difference between a main clause and a subordinate clause, using an example sentence of your own.
questions.hint: Which clause can stand alone?

en_read.topic: Term 1 review: Gothic, detective fiction and poetry

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which of these is a typical feature of Gothic fiction?
options: A gloomy, isolated setting such as a ruined castle
questions.answer: A gloomy, isolated setting such as a ruined castle

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In detective fiction, what is a 'red herring'?
options: A misleading clue that distracts from the truth
The final solution to the crime
A clue that proves who is guilty
questions.answer: A misleading clue that distracts from the truth
questions.hint: It sends the reader in the wrong direction.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: How many lines does a sonnet have?
questions.hint: It is more than twelve.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In many sonnets, what is the 'volta'?
options: A turn or shift in thought or argument
The first word of the poem
questions.answer: A turn or shift in thought or argument
questions.hint: The word comes from the Italian for 'turn'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: One common sonnet form is made of three quatrains followed by what?
questions.hint: It is the final two lines.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is the name for a line of poetry with ten syllables in an unstressed–stressed pattern?
questions.hint: 'Penta' means five.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which detail would most likely create suspense in a Gothic story?
options: A candle flickering out in an empty corridor
A cheerful picnic in the park
questions.answer: A candle flickering out in an empty corridor

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What does the term 'whodunnit' refer to?
options: A mystery story in which the reader tries to work out who committed a crime
A diary of a famous traveller
questions.answer: A mystery story in which the reader tries to work out who committed a crime

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In the line 'The wind howled through the broken windows', which technique is used?
questions.hint: Can wind really howl?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which is the best way to support a point in an analytical paragraph?
options: Use a short, relevant quotation and explain its effect
Give your opinion with no evidence
Copy out a full page of the text
questions.answer: Use a short, relevant quotation and explain its effect

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: A detective notices mud on a visitor's boots and concludes they walked across the fields. What skill is the detective using?
questions.hint: Reaching a conclusion from evidence.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What word describes the overall feeling or atmosphere a writer creates in a text?
questions.hint: In Gothic fiction it is often dark and tense.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Why might a writer use short sentences at the climax of a story?
options: To build tension and quicken the pace
To make the text easier to skip
To slow the reader right down
questions.answer: To build tension and quicken the pace

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: In the quotation 'Her heart was a trapped bird', what is the effect of the metaphor?
options: It suggests she feels panicked and desperate to escape
It suggests she is calm and peaceful
questions.answer: It suggests she feels panicked and desperate to escape
questions.hint: Think how a trapped bird behaves.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Explain how a writer of Gothic fiction might use setting to create a sense of fear. Refer to at least two techniques.
questions.hint: Think about light, sound and isolation.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Why do you think detective stories often hold back the solution until the final chapter?
questions.hint: Think about the reader's experience.

fre.topic: Term 1 review: holidays, routine and free time

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Choose the correct French for "I went to the beach."
options: Je suis allé à la plage.
questions.answer: Je suis allé à la plage.
questions.hint: Aller is one of the verbs that use être in the passé composé.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which of these verbs uses être (not avoir) in the passé composé?
questions.hint: Think of verbs of movement, like coming and going.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete with the past participle of manger: "Hier, j'ai ___ une pizza."
questions.hint: -er verbs change their ending to -é.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write the past participle of faire.
questions.hint: It is irregular and has four letters.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete with the correct form of être: "Nous ___ partis en vacances en août."
questions.hint: Use the present tense of être for nous.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Choose the correct word: "Elle est ___ en Espagne."
questions.hint: With être, the past participle agrees with a feminine singular subject.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which sentence puts the negative in the correct place?
options: Je n'ai pas regardé la télé.
Je n'ai regardé pas la télé.
Je ne pas ai regardé la télé.
Je n'ai pas regarder la télé.
questions.answer: Je n'ai pas regardé la télé.
questions.hint: Ne … pas goes around the auxiliary verb.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: What does "le week-end dernier" mean?
questions.hint: Dernier is often used to talk about the past.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete with the reflexive pronoun: "Je ___ lève à sept heures."
questions.hint: Which pronoun goes with je?

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete with the reflexive pronoun: "Le matin, nous ___ douchons."
questions.hint: The reflexive pronoun matches the subject.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: What does "Ils se couchent à dix heures" mean?
options: They go to bed at ten o'clock.
They get up at ten o'clock.
They get dressed at ten o'clock.
They have a wash at ten o'clock.
questions.answer: They go to bed at ten o'clock.
questions.hint: Think of une couchette, a bed on a train.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Which phrase means "I find it boring"?
questions.hint: Look for the negative adjective.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Choose the correct comparative: "Le tennis est ___ intéressant ___ le golf." (more … than)
questions.hint: "Than" in a French comparison is a short word starting with q.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Complete with the French for "better": "Le foot est ___ que le rugby."
questions.hint: It is irregular – you do not say plus bon.

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write 2–3 sentences in French about what you did last weekend. Use the passé composé and give one opinion.
questions.hint: Use j'ai + participle or je suis + participle, then c'était …

questions.subject: fre
questions.q: Write 2–3 sentences in French comparing two free-time activities. Use plus … que or moins … que and give a reason with parce que.
questions.hint: For example, compare reading and playing video games.

geog.topic: Term 1 review: rocks, tectonics and coasts

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which type of rock forms when magma or lava cools and hardens?
questions.hint: The name comes from the Latin word for fire.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Granite is an example of which rock type?
questions.hint: It has large crystals because it cooled slowly underground.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which type of rock forms from layers of sediment that are compressed and cemented over a long time?
questions.hint: The name comes from the material it is made of.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Freeze-thaw is an example of which type of weathering?
questions.hint: Water expands when it freezes and breaks the rock apart without changing its chemistry.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is the layer of the Earth below the crust, made of hot, semi-molten rock?
questions.hint: Convection currents in this layer move the plates.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: At which type of plate boundary do plates move apart?
questions.hint: New crust is built here.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: When an oceanic plate sinks beneath a continental plate, what type of boundary is it?
questions.hint: Crust is lost as one plate is subducted.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: The San Andreas Fault in California lies on which type of plate boundary?
questions.hint: Here plates slide past each other.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which of these coastal landforms is formed by erosion?
questions.hint: The others are made of material that has been dropped by the sea.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is the correct order of features formed as a headland erodes?
questions.hint: Start with the smallest weakness in the rock.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is the name of the process that moves sediment along a coast in a zigzag pattern?
questions.hint: Waves arrive at an angle but go back straight down the beach.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: A spit is mainly formed by:
questions.hint: It grows where the coastline changes direction.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: What is the name of the armchair-shaped hollow on a mountainside where a glacier began?
questions.hint: In Wales it is called a cwm.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Which process of glacial erosion happens when rocks frozen into the glacier are pulled away as it moves?
questions.hint: Think of picking something off.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Imagine an annotated diagram of a wave-cut platform. Write two annotations explaining how it forms.
questions.hint: Think about where the waves attack the cliff and what happens to the rock above.

questions.subject: geog
questions.q: Explain two reasons why many people choose to live near volcanoes despite the risks.
questions.hint: Think about the soil, jobs and tourism.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year did Henry VIII become king of England?
questions.hint: It is the first year of the period you studied this term.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Henry VIII broke with the Roman Catholic Church mainly because the Pope refused to:
options: annul his marriage to Catherine of Aragon
let him go to war with France
questions.answer: annul his marriage to Catherine of Aragon
questions.hint: He wanted a male heir and a new wife.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which 1534 Act made the monarch Supreme Head of the Church of England?
questions.hint: Its name is about having the highest power.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What happened during the Dissolution of the Monasteries?
options: Monasteries were closed and their land and wealth taken by the Crown
New monasteries were built across England
Monks were given seats in Parliament
Monasteries became schools run by the Pope
questions.answer: Monasteries were closed and their land and wealth taken by the Crown
questions.hint: Dissolve means to break up or end.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which Tudor monarch was nicknamed "Bloody Mary" because Protestants were burned during her reign?
questions.hint: She was Henry VIII's eldest daughter and a Catholic.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What did Elizabeth I's religious settlement of 1559 create?
options: A Protestant Church of England that kept some Catholic traditions
A Catholic Church controlled by the Pope
A Puritan church with no bishops
questions.answer: A Protestant Church of England that kept some Catholic traditions
questions.hint: It is often called the "middle way".

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year did the Spanish Armada sail against England?
questions.hint: It was thirty years after Elizabeth I became queen in 1558.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Who became king of England in 1603, uniting the crowns of England and Scotland?
questions.hint: He was already James VI of Scotland.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What is the name of the 1605 Catholic plot to blow up Parliament?
questions.hint: It is remembered on 5 November.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year did the English Civil War begin?
questions.hint: It started in the reign of Charles I.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What were supporters of Charles I in the Civil War called?
questions.hint: Their opponents were named after their short haircuts.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Which of these was a long-term cause of the English Civil War?
options: Arguments between Charles I and Parliament over taxes and power
The defeat of the Spanish Armada
questions.answer: Arguments between Charles I and Parliament over taxes and power
questions.hint: Look for a problem that built up over many years before 1642.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: In which year was Charles I executed?
questions.hint: It was a few years after the Civil War began in 1642.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: What name is given to the events of 1688 when William and Mary replaced James II?
questions.hint: It happened with very little fighting in England.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: Explain one reason why Henry VIII's break with Rome increased the power of the monarchy.
questions.hint: Think about who controlled the Church, its money and its land afterwards.

questions.subject: hist
questions.q: "Religion was the main cause of the English Civil War." Give one argument for and one argument against this statement.
questions.hint: Consider religion, money and the power of Parliament.

math.topic: Term 1 review: indices, percentages and algebra

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Work out 2⁵.
questions.hint: Multiply 2 by itself five times.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Work out 5⁰.
questions.hint: Any non-zero number to the power 0 has the same value.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Simplify a³ × a⁴.
questions.hint: When multiplying powers of the same base, add the indices.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Simplify x⁸ ÷ x².
questions.hint: When dividing powers of the same base, subtract the indices.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which is equal to 3⁻²?
questions.hint: A negative index means a reciprocal.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Find 15% of 80.
questions.hint: Find 10% and 5%, then add them.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Increase 60 by 20%.
questions.hint: Find 20% of 60 and add it on.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A jacket costs £50. In a sale the price is reduced by 30%. What is the new price in pounds?
questions.hint: Find 30% of £50 and take it away.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Write 18 out of 24 as a percentage.
questions.hint: Simplify the fraction first.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A price rises from £40 to £50. What is the percentage increase?
questions.hint: Divide the increase by the original price.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Simplify the ratio 12 : 18.
questions.hint: Divide both parts by their highest common factor.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Share £45 in the ratio 2 : 3. How much is the larger share in pounds?
questions.hint: First find how many parts there are altogether.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Solve 3x + 5 = 20.
questions.hint: Subtract 5 from both sides first.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Solve 2(x − 4) = 10.
questions.hint: You could divide both sides by 2 first.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Solve 5x − 3 = 2x + 9.
questions.hint: Collect the x terms on one side.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Explain why (2³)² is equal to 2⁶ and not 2⁵.
questions.hint: Write out (2³)² as a multiplication.

pt.topic: Revisão do 1º trimestre: verbos e termos da oração

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Se eu tivesse tempo, viajaria.", em que modo está o verbo "tivesse"?
questions.hint: Esse modo expressa hipótese ou possibilidade.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Feche a porta, por favor.", em que modo está o verbo "feche"?
questions.hint: O verbo expressa um pedido ou uma ordem.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Ela estuda todos os dias.", em que modo está o verbo "estuda"?
questions.hint: O verbo apresenta um fato como certo.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual é o sujeito da oração "Os alunos organizaram a feira de ciências."?
questions.hint: Pergunte ao verbo: quem organizou?

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "O menino comprou um livro.", o verbo "comprou" é:
questions.hint: Quem compra, compra algo – há preposição?

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Nós gostamos de música.", o verbo "gostamos" é:
questions.hint: Observe a preposição depois do verbo.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "O bebê dormiu.", o verbo "dormiu" é:
questions.hint: O verbo precisa de complemento para ter sentido completo?

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual é o objeto direto em "A professora corrigiu as provas."?
questions.hint: Pergunte: corrigiu o quê?

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual é o objeto indireto em "Ana precisa de ajuda."?
questions.hint: O complemento começa com preposição.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Entreguei o presente à minha avó.", a expressão "à minha avó" é:
questions.hint: Entreguei algo a alguém.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual destes é um verbo de ligação?
questions.hint: Verbos de ligação ligam o sujeito a uma característica.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual é o predicativo do sujeito em "O céu ficou escuro."?
questions.hint: Que característica é atribuída ao céu?

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "A tarde estava fria.", o predicado é:
questions.hint: O núcleo do predicado é uma característica, não uma ação.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Eles saíram cedo.", o predicado é:
questions.hint: O núcleo do predicado é uma ação.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em "Os meninos chegaram cansados.", o predicado é:
questions.hint: Há uma ação e também uma característica do sujeito.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Crie uma frase com um verbo transitivo direto e indireto (como dar, entregar ou emprestar) e indique qual é o objeto direto e qual é o objeto indireto.
questions.hint: Quem dá, dá alguma coisa a alguém.

pt_leit.topic: Revisão do 1º trimestre: narrativas, crônicas e poesia

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Qual gênero é um texto curto, sobre fatos do cotidiano, com tom leve e às vezes humorístico, muitas vezes publicado em jornais?
questions.hint: O nome vem de uma palavra grega ligada ao tempo.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Em uma narrativa de mistério, o que costuma movimentar a história?
options: Um enigma que precisa ser resolvido
A opinião do autor sobre um tema
questions.answer: Um enigma que precisa ser resolvido
questions.hint: Pense no trabalho de um detetive.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Em uma história de mistério, como se chama uma informação que leva o leitor a suspeitar da pessoa errada?
questions.hint: É uma pista, mas engana.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Como se chama o momento de maior tensão de uma narrativa?
questions.hint: É o ponto alto da história, antes da solução.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Como se chama a parte final de uma narrativa, em que o conflito se resolve?
questions.hint: Começa com "des".

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Que tipo de narrador participa da história e conta os fatos usando "eu"?
questions.hint: Ele também é alguém da história.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Que tipo de narrador conhece os pensamentos e sentimentos de todos os personagens?
questions.hint: Esse narrador sabe tudo.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Como se chama cada linha de um poema?
questions.hint: Não é o mesmo que estrofe.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Como se chama um conjunto de versos em um poema?
questions.hint: É como um "parágrafo" do poema.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Como se chama a repetição de sons parecidos no final dos versos?
questions.hint: Pense em "coração" e "canção".

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Em "Seus olhos eram duas estrelas", qual figura de linguagem aparece?
questions.hint: Há uma comparação sem a palavra "como".

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Em "Chorei rios de lágrimas", qual figura de linguagem aparece?
questions.hint: Há um exagero proposital.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Qual é o principal objetivo de uma reportagem?
options: Informar sobre um assunto com dados, entrevistas e investigação
questions.answer: Informar sobre um assunto com dados, entrevistas e investigação
questions.hint: Pense em um texto jornalístico mais aprofundado que a notícia.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Qual é uma diferença entre reportagem e crônica?
options: A reportagem busca ser objetiva e usa fontes; a crônica é mais pessoal e reflexiva
A reportagem é sempre em versos; a crônica, em prosa
A crônica usa entrevistas; a reportagem nunca usa
questions.answer: A reportagem busca ser objetiva e usa fontes; a crônica é mais pessoal e reflexiva
questions.hint: Qual delas mostra mais o olhar do autor?

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia: "Toda manhã, o vendedor de pão assobiava a mesma música, e a rua inteira acordava sorrindo." Que sentimento o narrador transmite sobre a rua? Justifique com uma palavra do trecho.
questions.hint: Observe as ações das pessoas da rua.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Explique, com suas palavras, uma diferença entre ler um poema e ler uma narrativa.
questions.hint: Pense na forma do texto e no que cada um procura transmitir.

sci.topic: Term 1 review: nutrition, respiration and chemical reactions

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Which nutrient is the body's main source of energy?
questions.hint: Bread, rice and pasta are rich in it.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Which nutrient is needed mainly for growth and repair of body tissues?
questions.hint: Found in meat, fish, eggs and beans.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Complete the word equation for aerobic respiration: glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + ___
questions.hint: It is also a product you breathe out as vapour.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: In which part of the cell does aerobic respiration mainly take place?
questions.hint: Often called the powerhouse of the cell.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: What is produced by anaerobic respiration in human muscles?
questions.hint: It can make your muscles ache during hard exercise.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Complete the word equation for photosynthesis: carbon dioxide + water → glucose + ___
questions.hint: Plants release this gas, which we need to breathe.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Which green pigment absorbs light for photosynthesis?
questions.hint: It is found inside chloroplasts.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: In which part of a plant cell does photosynthesis take place?
questions.hint: These parts contain the green pigment.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: What are the vertical columns of the Periodic Table called?
questions.hint: The horizontal rows have a different name.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: What are the elements in Group 1 of the Periodic Table called?
questions.hint: They react with water to form alkaline solutions.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Which of these is a sign that a chemical reaction has happened?
questions.hint: The others are physical changes that can be reversed.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Complete the word equation: magnesium + oxygen → ___
questions.hint: When a metal burns in oxygen, it forms an oxide.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Complete the word equation: hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → ___ + water
questions.hint: The salt's name comes from the metal and the acid.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: In a closed container, 10 g of reactants react completely. What is the total mass of the products in grams?
questions.hint: Mass is conserved in a chemical reaction.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Iron reacting with oxygen and water to form rust is an example of:
questions.hint: The metal gains oxygen.

questions.subject: sci
questions.q: Explain why photosynthesis and respiration are sometimes described as "opposite" processes.
questions.hint: Compare the reactants and products of the two word equations.

spa.topic: Term 1 review: holidays, routine and free time

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Choose the correct Spanish for "I went to the beach."
questions.hint: The preterite of ir for yo is irregular.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Complete with the preterite of comer (yo): "Ayer ___ paella."
questions.hint: -er verbs end in -í for yo in the preterite.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Complete with the preterite of jugar (yo): "El sábado ___ al fútbol."
questions.hint: Watch out for the spelling change before -é.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: In "Visitamos a mis abuelos el verano pasado", who did the visiting?
questions.hint: Look at the verb ending -amos.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Choose the correct preterite form: "Ella ___ un libro muy interesante." (leer)
questions.hint: The i changes to y between vowels.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: What does "el verano pasado" mean?
questions.hint: Pasado is used to talk about the past.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Which sentence is correctly made negative?
questions.hint: No goes before the verb.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Complete with the present tense of levantarse (yo): "Me ___ a las siete."
questions.hint: The pronoun me is already there; add the yo form of the verb.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Complete with the reflexive pronoun: "Nosotros ___ duchamos por la mañana."
questions.hint: The reflexive pronoun matches the subject.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: What does "Se acuestan a las diez" mean?
options: They go to bed at ten.
They have a shower at ten.
questions.answer: They go to bed at ten.
questions.hint: Acostarse is the opposite of levantarse.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: What does "Me encanta" mean?
questions.hint: It is stronger than me gusta.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Which phrase means "I think it's boring"?
questions.hint: Look for the negative adjective.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Choose the correct comparative: "El baloncesto es ___ emocionante ___ el golf." (more … than)
questions.hint: "Than" in a Spanish comparison is a short word starting with q.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Complete with the Spanish for "better": "El fútbol es ___ que el tenis."
questions.hint: It is irregular – you do not say más bueno.

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Write 2–3 sentences in Spanish about your last holiday. Use the preterite and give one opinion.
questions.hint: Use fui, visité or comí, then fue …

questions.subject: spa
questions.q: Write 2–3 sentences in Spanish describing your daily routine. Use at least two reflexive verbs.
questions.hint: For example: me levanto, me ducho, me acuesto.
